newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Balabac gets new controlling shareholder.
newsitem.headline: Balabac gets new controlling shareholder.

text.p: Balabac Oil Exploration & Drilling Co Inc said on Wednesday it had entered into an agreement under which the Nikon Group of Companies would purchase 81 percent of Balabac's outstanding capital stock in exchange for land.
The Nikon Group is an unlisted, domestic company engaged in the property business, a Balabac official said.
Under the agreement, the Nikon Group would subscribe to a total of 203.8 billion shares with a par value of 2.038 billion pesos, the company said in a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange.
As payment, Nikon agreed to assign to Balabac several parcels of land with an appraised value of 1.312 billion pesos.
The remaining balance of 726.67 million pesos will be paid by Nikon with other real and personal properties not later than a month after the call of the board of directors, the statement said.
Last year, Balabac said its board approved the conversion of the company into a holding company from an oil drilling concern.
